eventsModeration.title: Event moderation
eventsModeration.subtitle: Review partner-submitted events before they go public.
eventsModeration.permissionBody: Only university moderators can moderate events.
eventsModeration.emptyBody: There are no events with this status right now.
eventsModeration.detailUnavailable: The full event description isn't available in this view.
eventsModeration.notPending: This event has already been handled.
eventsModeration.approveNote: The partner will be notified once the event is published.
eventsModeration.rejectBody: Let the partner know why “{title}” was rejected.
eventsModeration.reasonHint: This reason will be sent to the partner.
eventsModeration.requestChangesBody: Send “{title}” back to the organizer to revise and resubmit.
eventsModeration.requestChangesHint: The organizer receives this and can revise and resubmit the event.
eventsModeration.changesRequestedToast: Sent back to the organizer for changes.
eventsModeration.conflictBody: This event was just changed elsewhere. We've refreshed the list.
eventsModeration.insightManyPending: Multiple events are waiting for review — approve soon to allow promotion
eventsModeration.insightOnePending: One event is pending your review and approval
eventsModeration.insightQueueClear: Event review queue is clear — no pending submissions
eventsModeration.insightRejectedReview: Rejected events shown — organizers may be ready to resubmit with fixes
